name: p4_r_spec
statement: (n : ℕ) : n ≤ 2 ^ p4_r n ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ 2 ^ k → p4_r n ≤ k
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ 2 ^ p4_r n ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ 2 ^ k → p4_r n ≤ k
informal: The Lean definition p4_r agrees with the paper's: r(n) is the least non-negative integer with n <= 2^r(n).
original: r(n) is the least non-negative integer with n ≤ 2^{r(n)}
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ 2 ^ Mathlib2.p4_r n ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ), n ≤ 2 ^ k → Mathlib2.p4_r n ≤ k
